processes.orchestrator: bench/runtime/run.py; G1 client requests and G6 property cases
processes.shaper: bench/runtime/workers.py shaper: crosstalk.shaper.server.run() with ShaperSettings from CT_SHAPER_* env (uvloop), metrics exported to a file
